authority: inert complete-byte equality only; no TLS/cert/freshness/readiness/backend authority
hash_domain: Complete descriptor bytes; no added prefix.

valid.notes: Complete binary descriptor including opaque raw trust bytes, ASCII pin, magic/contract/fixed trailer.
Opaque all-zero trust digest is data, never proof of an actual anchor.
Existing M2-C01 DNS grammar permits one-label names; ::1 is canonical numeric unicast. Zero generation is lexically valid, not fresh.
Three routes, eight peers each; global cap dominates individual maxima; complete valid grammar exactly 8192 bytes.

invalid.notes: One-byte over total cap; all individual field lengths and grammar remain valid.
Routes must arrive sorted by ID.
Distinct IDs do not permit duplicate public DNS/port authority.

truncation_oracle.range_semantics: Every integer in this inclusive range rejects; includes all interior offsets.
